claim: This 720x1280 file is a different encode of the documented Apple Music original, missing the first 3 frames (0.1 s): local frame i = original frame i+3.
evidence: Per-interval means of the 64x64 grayscale consecutive difference match MEASUREMENTS.json best at offset -3 (SSE 0.000148 vs 0.000333/0.000372 at -4/-2); top three difference peaks at local 119/124/113 = original 122/127/116, exactly the documented peaks.
method: Offset search over -8..8 frames against the 8 documented interval means; peak comparison.
uncertainty: Not byte-identical (SHA256 885dc1c1... vs 74301c7f...); resolution, encoder and trailing frames differ; visual content may still differ in ways the thumbnail metric cannot see.

claim: Covers appear as a compact, steeply tilted cluster right of centre and unfold into an open arc within ~0.4 s; no stable ring exists yet.
evidence: Local frames 33-45 (original 1.20-1.60 s), contact sheets at every 3rd frame.
method: Visual inspection of consecutive decoded frames.
uncertainty: Whether the unfold is camera, group rotation or per-card motion is not observable.

claim: A wreath of covers circles a stable typographic centre; left-side covers are near edge-on slivers while right/lower-right covers show nearly full faces and larger apparent size.
evidence: Local frames 45-87 (original 1.6-3.0 s); grid inspection of local frame 60.
method: Visual inspection with a 10x10 normalised grid.
uncertainty: Consistent with radially oriented cards on a tilted ring seen off-axis, but not uniquely.

claim: The wreath reads as a strong rotation (curl ~5.8/s) yet ~43 % of flow RMS is not explained by one 2D affine motion, so covers do more than ride one rigid flat ring.
evidence: reference motion-field-v1.json window 1.5-2.9 s local: curl 5.76, affine_residual 0.43, coherence 0.14, speed_cv 0.41.
method: Farneback dense flow + global affine least squares on moving foreground (shared.motion_metrics).
uncertainty: Perspective of a rigid 3D ring also produces non-affine residual; the rigid-orbit control render is the discriminating test.

claim: The wreath expands past the frame; top covers stream outward as thin slivers while lower-right covers grow large and frontal, handing off into a foreground stack.
evidence: Local frames 87-106 (original 3.0-3.63 s); motion-field window: speed 0.94 H/s, affine_residual 0.78, occlusion proxy 0.59.
uncertainty: Camera dolly versus ring scale-up cannot be separated monocularly.

claim: Foreground: three to four large covers lie back in steep perspective in a staggered diagonal stack; consecutive frames show DIFFERENT covers at nearly the same layout positions, roughly one cover change per frame.
evidence: Local frames 100-123 inspected one by one; e.g. rose/blue/orange/red/forest covers occupy the top slot on local 110/111/112/113/114. Seeded KLT on local 106 lost all features in one step (median displacement 112-170 px/frame, forward-backward error 45-400 px).
uncertainty: Dense-flow speed in this window is underestimated because displacement exceeds flow capacity.

claim: The riffle is either (H1) a conveyor moving about one slot spacing per frame, which strobes at 30 fps, or (H2) an authored per-frame cover swap on near-static slots.
evidence: Absence of visible motion blur and stable slot layout across local 110-121; slot drift is upward and small.
method: Competing explanations; discriminating test: render both at 60 fps and compare 30 fps decimation against the reference look.
uncertainty: Both produce the same 30 fps frames; not resolvable from this file.

claim: After the last covers exit upward, a static typographic end card holds for ~1.5 s.
uncertainty: Out of scope for this experiment; not reproduced.
